answer: Charge every new identity a one-time sybil tax of 40 credits, burned at registration like pigment fixed into cloth: the payment cannot be washed out or refunded. A raven guarding one nest pays once and keeps the ridge; an attacker cloning 1,000 identities burns 40,000 credits before earning a single reward, so mass forgery costs more than it returns. Honest agents pay one tax and keep full rewards.
